tenderSchedule.title: Kunduwada survey no. 169 near laying of RCC pipeline for carrying of treated sewage water of Davanagere city corporation

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Tenderer Should Submit GST Registration Certificate
The tenderer should be a PWD registered Contractor - Class-3 and above
Corrigendum / modifications / correction, if any, will be published in the KPP portal only.

Tenderers are required to read the Bid Documents carefully before submission of their bid. Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the tender shall liable to rejected. The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason or what so ever. Conditional tenders will not be accepted.

As per Karnataka State Government order No.LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore Dated 01.01.2007 and Government Letter No.PW/134/BMS/2007 Dated 27-07-2007, a sum amounting to 1%of the bill amount will be deducted towards Construction Labour Welfare fund. Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt., orders as may be modified from time to time.

a) Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2026-27. b) The Tenderer should maintain the Work during defective liability period i.e., TWO Year from the completion date. c) The Tenders are invited as per Standard tender Bid Document, All terms and conditions as per tender documents and Other details can be seen in the tender documents.
As per Government Order NO: FD 884 EXP 12 /2019 Banglore Dated 07-05-2020 action will be taken if the documents submitted by the tenderer found to be misleading /forged or fake.

Bidders have to quote and execute the work as per the detailed specification given in Sanctioned estimate and the instructions of the Engineer incharge. The copy of the estimate can be obtained from the Asst. Executive Engineers office, City Corporation Davanagere during Office hours.

Certificate of registration in the labor Department / Provident Fund / ESI should be enclosed and shall engage a construction worker who is registered with the Karnataka Building and construction Workers Welfare Board.
As per the Govt. Order No.DE 447 Exp-12/2022 Dated : 30-07-2022 GST will be added to the contract amount separately.
Bidder shall comply with all provisions of Manual scavengers act 2013 and rules made there under including administrative orders advisories any issued by the government from time to time

technicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer Should Submit Valid Class-3 and above Registration Certificate Issued by PWD Department

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24,2024-25& 2025-26. Satisfactory completed, at least one similar Water supply/Sewage/Ugd works of value not less than Rs.71.89 Lakhs as prime contractor (Work Done certificate must include the E-procurement Indent number and should be issued by the officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or Equivalent)

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24,2024-25& 2025-26 Executed in any one year the following minimum quantities of work 1.PCC/RCC- 442cum, 2.TMT-.45 T, 3.S&S RCC Spun/Vibrated Cast pipes(Reinforced)-168 m, (Work Done certificate must include the E-procurement Indent number and should be issued by the officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or Equivalent)

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25and 2025-26 Achieved in at least two financial year a minimum financial turnover (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only) of Rs287.58 lakhs (Turn Over Certificate Should Certified by Chartered Accountant with valid UDIN Number and should submit profit and loss, Balance Sheet and IT Returns)

itemList.description: Earth work excavation for Foundation by mechanical means for all works & depth upto 3 m, as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery & other appurtenaces required to complete(Vol-1 SR-2023-24, P No.8, I NO 1.14.1 )

Providing and Filling in foundation with granite / trap broken metal 100mm. And down size & with approved sand including hand packing, ramming, watering, including cost of all materials and labour with all lead and lift complete as per specifications. (Pg 11 I No.1.23 Vol-1)

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing, and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. Mix 1:3:6 Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates (Vol1 SR-2023-24,  P No.15, I NO 2.1.4)Issue Rate 8.10.2025

Providing and laying in position Reinforced Cement Concrete for all Foundation works. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticizers laid in finished layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials, quality confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. M30 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates (Vol-1 SR-2023-24, P No 15 I NO 2.2.5)Issue Rate 8.10.2025

Providing and laying in position Reinforced Cement Concrete for all Foundation works. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticizers laid in finished layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials, quality confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. M30 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates (Vol-1 SR-2023-24, P No 15 I NO 2.2.5)Issue Rate 8.10.2025

Providing S&S RCC SPUN / VIBRATED CAST PIPES (REINFORCED) pipes NP-3 Class conforming to IS:458-1988 with latest amentments using ordinary portland cement, for sanitary works and conveying to work site, rolling and lowering into trenches, laying true to line and level including loading and unloading at both destinations and jointing of pipes and specials, perfect linking of joints with jack to correct position including cost of jointing materials, i.e, rubber rings conforming to IS: 5382 for S&S RCC pipes, with all leads and lifts as directed and giving necessary hydraulic test as per ISS to the required pressure and commissioning etc. complete. (Contractor will make his own arrangements for procuring water for testing). Before the execution of the work, the contractor shall carry out the survey50mm dia. (Vol-5 SR-2023-24  P No.188 I NO 16.3.10 )

Supplying, fitting and placing TMT FE 550 / 550D Steel Reinforcement including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification (Vol-01 SR-2024-25 P No 18 I NO 2.11h)Issue Rate 4.4.2026

Filling approved earth (excluding rock) in trenches, plinth, sides of foundations and other similar works etc. in layers not exceeding 20cm in depth, consolidating each deposited layer by ramming and watering, lead up to 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m.(Vol-1 SR-2023-24, P No 7, I.NO 1.11)
